sentences.text: Tafejul @ Tofijul Haque vs Unknown on 11 September, 2024

Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen
 11.09.2024
 Ad-45
 Court No.29
 Tn
 (Allowed)
 Crm (A) 3251 of 2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Se  the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 corresponding to  482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 f  connection with Islampur Police Station Case No. 760   dated 05.12.2019 under Sections 498A/307 of the IPC.
 And  In the matter of: Tafejul @ Tofijul Haque  .
 Mr. Amit Roy  ..
 Mr. Jannat Ul Firdous  ....for the d  Mr. Anwar Hossain,
 Mr. Sharequl Haque  
 1.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
2. The learned counsel for the de facto complainant submits that she is living peacefully with her husband, that is, the petitioner and the disputes have been amicably settled.
3. Considering the aforesaid facts, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is allowed.

4. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner, namely, Tafejul @ Tofijul Haque shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.2,000/-, with one surety, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, corresponding to Section 482(2) of the BNSS, 2023.

Signed By :
